notes: Modified cash basis city (FYE 9/30/2023). Governmental lines from the Totals column of the governmental funds statement (pp6-7); fund-balance roll-forward 2,463,188 + 2,646,261 - 2,789,340 + transfers in 100,000 + issuance of debt 37,862 = 2,457,971. Governmental transfers in 100,000 came from the Electric Fund; the proprietary statement's net 'Operating transfers in (out)' 86,984 = Electric (100,000) + Water 134,101 + Sewer 52,883, the inflows being ARPA-funded capital outlay (186,984) that the governmental funds report as ARPA capital outlay expenditure (p12 noncash disclosure); recorded as printed. Cash: governmental fund assets are all cash lines (cash and certificates of deposit, restricted cash, cash at county treasurer); cash and CDs are combined, so investments are left null. Business-type from the modified cash proprietary funds statement p10 (ties to the Statement of Activities pp2-3); capital contribution grants 7,143 in business_type.other_financing; the accrual-basis proprietary statements pp17-19 (supplementary) are not used. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), because its governmental figures include capital assets and debt; lines split by Governmental / Business-Type columns, totals from the Total column. Detail: General Fund schedule by department (pp15-16, one line per department column) and the proprietary fund columns of p10. The combined all-funds budget statement (pp13-14) is not recorded (combined across all funds; per-fund detail used instead). Other governmental funds (Keno, Street, CDBG Housing Rehab, ARPA, Debt Service) have no schedule of their own and are not added to detail. Read pages 1-19 of 19
